svg.title: Mitigation Witness: counts, uncertainty and verdicts
svg.desc: A source example preserves raw count spellings and total 50 while mapping declared register spaces to counts 24 and 26. Exact rational representation remains distinct from accuracy. Native readout/parity/ZNE outputs, prescribed uncertainty and certified retention comparisons keep their assumptions. Actual Common report transport is separate from unfinished native/domain acceptance. Source reading only; no measurement or experiment performed.

g.text: ANULUM / QUANTUM COMPUTING SYSTEMS
Mitigation Witness: counts, uncertainty and verdicts
In progress · source reading 2026-10-20 · whole native verification and consumer admission remain open
1 / PRESERVE RAW INPUT BEFORE INTERPRETATION — SOURCE EXAMPLE ONLY
Original count inventory
Width: 2; reported shots: 50
Complete explicit raw-label map
Original spellings remain available
Declared normalisation
Remove only declared register spaces
No lost shots or changed bitstrings
This example is not a measurement
Keep exact quantities
Wire: numerator 2, denominator 4
Keep original rational spelling
Value equality ≠ source identity
Exact float value ≠ error bound
2 / NATIVE METHOD OUTPUTS AND UNCERTAINTY HAVE DIFFERENT RESPONSIBILITIES
Native source study
Readout / parity / ZNE use the parent implementation
Preserve raw, mitigated and known-answer points
All prescribed cases, original custody and refusals
Calibration and fit / held-out overlap stay visible
Source replay does not prove mitigation benefit
Prescribed uncertainty
Original confidence / dependence / criterion bounds
Selected exact-binomial root enclosure and work limits
Compare inside / outside / overlap; no invented error
Zero retained can keep retention interval evidence
Conditional mean can still be unavailable
Source workflow in progress: plan / attach / evaluate / seal / verify / inspect / render
Six command routes and an actual verify_common phase exist; full native verification remains unfinished.
Actual Evidence Manifest Toolkit interfaces retain the complete fifteen-field Common report and native diagnostics.
Common success, a candidate certificate or a rendered document does not establish native/current scientific acceptance.
3 / KEEP THE ASSUMPTIONS AND EVIDENCE GAPS VISIBLE
Sampling and acquisition scope
A histogram or job label does not prove independence
Missing acquisition must not become measured zero
Fit-data reuse remains explicit; no hidden hold-out claim
Root bounds still assume the declared binomial model
Separate domain acceptance
Native numerical and physical source qualification
Earlier prescription, calibration, Clock and process scope
Family coverage, target transfer and complete verifier
Owning consumer / Studio admission remains open
Concrete contributor and partner roles
Original job / calibration / acquisition custody; independently qualified native and statistical supplier profiles.
Common authority and time, full native verification, prescribed independent validation and actual consumer integration.
These are required roles, not agreed partners, acquired equipment or a new successful witness.
Lossless counts, exact quantities, uncertainty enclosures and mitigation-benefit claims retain different meanings.
Selected complete source bytes and hashes support review; no source commit or scientific acceptance is implied.
No measurement / mitigation / statistics / Common / QPU experiment run · source-owner and publication review pending
